categories.name: Robot
categories.description: A programmed, actuated mechanism with a degree of autonomy that performs locomotion, manipulation or positioning (ISO 8373:2021).
categories.inclusion_rule: Sold as a complete, programmable robot. Parts sold separately are components (cp).

categories.name: Arm
categories.description: Fixed-base manipulator that positions an end-effector in space.
categories.inclusion_rule: Fixed base (floor, table, wall, ceiling or a separately sold mobile base); manipulates; not humanoid in form.

categories.name: Articulated arm
categories.description: Serial arm with three or more rotary joints, including 6/7-axis industrial arms, cobots and desktop arms.
categories.inclusion_rule: At least three rotary joints in series. Collaborative safety rating does not change the category (attribute collaborative).

categories.name: SCARA arm
categories.description: Arm with two parallel vertical rotary joints and a vertical linear axis, compliant in the horizontal plane.
categories.inclusion_rule: Two parallel vertical rotary joints plus a vertical prismatic axis.

categories.name: Parallel arm
categories.description: Parallel-kinematic manipulator such as a delta robot or hexapod / Stewart platform.
categories.inclusion_rule: End-effector carried by two or more kinematic chains acting in parallel.

categories.name: Cartesian arm
categories.description: Manipulator with three prismatic axes aligned to a Cartesian coordinate system, including gantry and linear robots.
categories.inclusion_rule: Three prismatic (linear) main axes.

categories.name: Cylindrical arm
categories.description: Manipulator with a rotary base, a prismatic lift and a prismatic reach, including polar / spherical arms.
categories.inclusion_rule: Rotary base combined with prismatic lift and reach axes.

categories.name: Humanoid
categories.description: Robot with a torso, two arms and a head in human proportion, intended for human environments.
categories.inclusion_rule: Torso plus two arms plus a head in human proportion. Locomotion decides the child category.

categories.name: Bipedal humanoid
categories.description: Humanoid that walks on two legs.
categories.inclusion_rule: Humanoid form with two articulated legs used for locomotion.

categories.name: Wheeled-base humanoid
categories.description: Humanoid upper body on a wheeled or tracked base.
categories.inclusion_rule: Humanoid torso, arms and head mounted on a wheeled or tracked base instead of legs.

categories.name: Fixed-base humanoid
categories.description: Humanoid upper body on a fixed mount, without locomotion.
categories.inclusion_rule: Humanoid torso, arms and head with no locomotion system.

categories.name: Legged robot
categories.description: Robot that moves on articulated legs and is not humanoid in form.
categories.inclusion_rule: Articulated legs; wheels on the feet or an add-on arm do not change the category.

categories.name: Quadruped
categories.description: Legged robot with four legs.
categories.inclusion_rule: Four articulated legs. Wheel-feet (attribute wheel_feet) and add-on arms (attribute has_arm) stay in this category.

categories.name: Biped
categories.description: Two-legged robot without a humanoid torso, arms and head.
categories.inclusion_rule: Two articulated legs; fails the humanoid test (no torso + two arms + head in human proportion).

categories.name: Multi-legged
categories.description: Legged robot with six or more legs.
categories.inclusion_rule: Six or more articulated legs.

categories.name: Ground robot
categories.description: Robot that moves on wheels or tracks, with no legs and no integrated arm.
categories.inclusion_rule: Wheels or tracks; no legs; no arm sold as part of the product (an add-on arm is attribute has_arm).

categories.name: Wheeled robot
categories.description: Ground robot driven by wheels.
categories.inclusion_rule: Locomotion by wheels. Vacuum, mowing, delivery, telepresence and similar are applications, not categories.

categories.name: Tracked robot
categories.description: Ground robot driven by continuous tracks.
categories.inclusion_rule: Locomotion by continuous tracks.

categories.name: Mobile manipulator
categories.description: Wheeled or tracked base with one or more arms, sold as one product, non-humanoid in form.
categories.inclusion_rule: Base and arm(s) sold together as one product. A base and an arm sold separately are two entries linked by compatible_with.

categories.name: Aerial robot
categories.description: Robot that flies.
categories.inclusion_rule: Primary operating medium is air.

categories.name: Multirotor
categories.description: Aerial robot lifted by multiple rotors.
categories.inclusion_rule: Lift from two or more rotors; no fixed wing.

categories.name: Fixed-wing
categories.description: Aerial robot lifted by a fixed wing.
categories.inclusion_rule: Lift from a fixed wing; cannot hover.

categories.name: Hybrid VTOL
categories.description: Aerial robot combining rotor-borne vertical take-off with fixed-wing cruise.
categories.inclusion_rule: Both rotors for vertical flight and a fixed wing for cruise.

categories.name: Aquatic robot
categories.description: Robot that operates on or in water.
categories.inclusion_rule: Primary operating medium is water. Amphibious products go to the medium they are marketed for.

categories.name: ROV
categories.description: Remotely operated underwater vehicle connected by a tether.
categories.inclusion_rule: Submersible; tethered; remotely operated.

categories.name: AUV
categories.description: Autonomous, untethered underwater vehicle.
categories.inclusion_rule: Submersible; untethered; autonomous.

categories.name: USV
categories.description: Unmanned surface vessel.
categories.inclusion_rule: Operates on the water surface.

categories.name: Wearable robot
categories.description: Robot worn on the human body.
categories.inclusion_rule: Worn on the body and powered (an unpowered exoskeleton is a robotic device, not a robot).

categories.name: Exoskeleton
categories.description: Powered exoskeleton or exosuit that assists or augments human movement.
categories.inclusion_rule: Powered actuation applied to one or more body regions.

categories.name: Stationary robot
categories.description: Fixed-base robot that does not manipulate, such as a desktop companion or social robot without arms.
categories.inclusion_rule: Fixed base; no locomotion; no manipulator. Last rule in the tie-break order.

categories.name: Kit
categories.description: Modular construction kit with no fixed body plan that produces a programmable robot.
categories.inclusion_rule: Sold as parts to be assembled into user-chosen forms; the result is programmable. Generic electronics kits are excluded.

categories.name: Component
categories.description: A robot part or accessory sold separately from a complete robot.
categories.inclusion_rule: Sold separately and intended to be fitted to, or used with, a robot.

categories.name: End-effector
categories.description: Device mounted at the end of an arm or wrist that acts on the world.
categories.inclusion_rule: Mounts to a robot wrist or tool flange and performs grasping or a process.

categories.name: Gripper
categories.description: Grasping end-effector that is not an anthropomorphic hand.
categories.inclusion_rule: Grasps objects; fewer than four fingers, no opposable thumb, or fewer than six DOF. Child category is decided by gripping principle, not actuation.

categories.name: Finger gripper
categories.description: Gripper with mechanical fingers or jaws, including parallel, angular and 2–3-finger adaptive designs.
categories.inclusion_rule: Grasps by closing rigid or semi-rigid fingers or jaws on the object.

categories.name: Vacuum gripper
categories.description: Gripper that holds by suction, including suction cups, foam and area grippers.
categories.inclusion_rule: Grasps by vacuum or suction.

categories.name: Magnetic gripper
categories.description: Gripper that holds ferrous objects by magnetic force.
categories.inclusion_rule: Grasps by permanent or electro-magnetic force.

categories.name: Soft gripper
categories.description: Gripper with compliant or inflatable fingers.
categories.inclusion_rule: Grasping surfaces are compliant elastomer or inflatable structures.

categories.name: Hand
categories.description: Anthropomorphic end-effector with four or more fingers including an opposable thumb and multiple degrees of freedom.
categories.inclusion_rule: At least four fingers including an opposable thumb and at least six degrees of freedom.

categories.name: Tool
categories.description: Process end-effector such as a welding torch, spindle, screwdriver, dispenser or camera head.
categories.inclusion_rule: Performs a process rather than grasping. A tool with a secondary gripping function is classified by its primary marketed purpose.

categories.name: Tool changer
categories.description: Quick-change coupling between a robot wrist and interchangeable end-effectors.
categories.inclusion_rule: Couples and decouples end-effectors; does not itself grasp or process.

categories.name: Actuator
categories.description: Device that produces motion for a robot joint or axis.
categories.inclusion_rule: Produces rotary or linear motion; sold as a unit, not integrated into a robot.

categories.name: Joint module
categories.description: Integrated rotary actuator unit combining motor, reducer, encoder and driver.
categories.inclusion_rule: Includes a reducer and industrial communications (EtherCAT, CAN) and is sold for robot joints.

categories.name: Servo
categories.description: Hobby or smart servo with built-in control and a daisy-chain bus.
categories.inclusion_rule: Packaged hobby-grade servo with built-in control; daisy-chain bus (TTL, RS485, CAN) or PWM.

categories.name: Motor
categories.description: Bare electric motor such as BLDC, stepper or frameless, without reducer or integrated control.
categories.inclusion_rule: Motor sold without an integrated reducer or servo controller.

categories.name: Reducer
categories.description: Gear reduction unit such as harmonic / strain-wave, cycloidal / RV or planetary.
categories.inclusion_rule: Reduces speed and multiplies torque; sold without a motor.

categories.name: Linear actuator
categories.description: Actuator producing straight-line motion, such as roller screw, ball screw, pneumatic or hydraulic cylinder.
categories.inclusion_rule: Output motion is linear.

categories.name: Sensor
categories.description: Device that measures the robot or its environment.
categories.inclusion_rule: Primary function is sensing. A camera with onboard AI is still a sensor.

categories.name: Camera
categories.description: Imaging sensor including RGB, depth, stereo, thermal and event cameras.
categories.inclusion_rule: Produces images or depth maps.

categories.name: Lidar
categories.description: Laser range sensor, 2D or 3D.
categories.inclusion_rule: Measures range by laser time-of-flight or phase.

categories.name: Force-torque sensor
categories.description: Sensor measuring force and torque at a wrist or joint, typically 3 or 6 axes.
categories.inclusion_rule: Measures force and/or torque along defined axes.

categories.name: Tactile sensor
categories.description: Sensor measuring contact, pressure or texture at a surface.
categories.inclusion_rule: Measures distributed contact over a surface.

categories.name: Inertial / encoder
categories.description: Motion and position sensors such as IMUs and encoders.
categories.inclusion_rule: Measures acceleration, angular rate, orientation or shaft position.

categories.name: Compute
categories.description: Robot controllers, single-board computers and edge-AI modules.
categories.inclusion_rule: Processing hardware without sensing.

categories.name: Power
categories.description: Battery packs, chargers and docking stations.
categories.inclusion_rule: Stores or supplies electrical energy to a robot.

categories.name: Structure
categories.description: Frames, mounts, enclosures, flanges and cable management.
categories.inclusion_rule: Mechanical parts with no actuation, sensing or compute.

categories.name: Teleoperation
categories.description: Devices for controlling a robot remotely or for collecting demonstration data, such as leader arms, haptic devices and VR or motion-capture rigs.
categories.inclusion_rule: Operated by a human to drive or teach a robot.
